messages: ADTM: Destroying manager while a mix has not ended
ADTM: Attempting to update control while a mix is ongoing, but realtime thread is disabled
resolution: Explicit --howl-smoke-test now skips presentation bootstrap and asserts no Prototype/AudioSource exists. Normal launches still bootstrap the game.
note: Failure occurred during native audio shutdown. The exact underlying native race is not established; this removes unnecessary presentation/audio initialization from the data-only test path.
